dogecoin.text:
This is speculative theater: a perpetual printing press pumping hype through celebs, not tech. A meme-coin propelled by social media clout—not fundamentals.
⚠️ Fun? Maybe. But risky for anyone who thinks it’s a serious asset.
🔗 https://t.co/ubU3QKqgEo https://t.co/OYMtTK1iUp

Its price jumps aren’t organic—they’re triggered by Elon Musk tweets. Studies show DOGE surges minutes after Musk posts, then often crashes  ￼ ￼ ￼.
🧠 It’s not decentralization—it’s personality-driven volatility.
🔗 https://t.co/1XUVbzOlWM

Dogecoin has no supply cap—miners create 10,000 DOGE every minute, adding ~5 billion coins annually, making it inflationary by design  . That undercuts its value and makes it a currency for spending, not a store of wealth.
